description: Verify cached platform solidification with fully occupied covering reservations.
preconditions: The isolated Backend uses its default two ordinary background slots.
assertions: A cached config and layer converge to an anchored platform manifest within 120 seconds of session association with at least 100 unrelated task records.

checks.description: Wake an existing Distribution quota waiter without a second reservation and record association, wake, execution, and anchor times.

outputs: Structured timing, task identities, task count, and upstream fetch evidence.
